provenance.basis: Reconstructed figure of John Simmons, private of Captain Nathan Heald's company of the First Infantry (on the company's muster-roll to 31 May 1812, Quaife 1913 App. VIII), before the small house in the north-east corner, on the afternoon of 14 August 1812. Where he stands and what he is doing are ours (liberty L-1812-garrison-stations-3462): no guard report or order book of the post survives for that day, and nothing of it is acted out. He wears the company private's dress (T-3451). His face, height and build are seeded from his own name; no picture of him is known.
provenance.replaceable_by: A guard report, order book or morning report of the post for August 1812, which would put him at his own duty.
